title: Ijwi ryageze ku ntebe y'ubwami
intro: Umuntu wari uremerewe yegereye urukiko, ijwi ryabo ritungurwa n’ubwoba ahubwo n’ibyiringiro. Ikibazo cyari icy’umuntu ku giti cye, ariko igisubizo cyacyo cyaragarutse uko ibihe byagiye bihita, gisenya umuco w’igitugu. Ni nde uyu muntu w’ikirego cy’umuntu cyumvwaga hirya no hino ku isi?
clues: Naje mfite umutima uremereye, nshaka ubutabera mu kibazo cyari kimboshye ku rurimi rwanjye.
Ntabwo nasabye intumwa gusa, ahubwo narazamutse cyane, ndumva byose.
Amagambo yavuzweho yari nk'iminyururu y'amateka ya kera.
Nagiye impaka kandi ntekereza, n'amarira n'ubwenge, kubera icyubahiro cyanjye.
Ihishurirwa ryaraje, ricecekesha inzira za kera kandi ryemera ububabare bwanjye.
Banyita uwatonganye ku mugabo wanjye, izina ryanjye rihinduka nk'igice cyamfashije kwibohora.

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
